description: The 'apps_with_no_instances' dataset provides detailed information about applications that currently have no active instances. This dataset is particularly useful for developers and project managers who need to track and manage applications within a software environment, such as Dataiku. Each entry in the dataset represents an application, identified by a unique 'appId', and includes metadata such as version, descriptive labels, and short descriptions. The dataset also includes boolean indicators for limited visibility, image presence, and usage as a recipe, which can help in understanding the application's deployment and usage status. Additionally, the dataset provides information about the application's origin, whether it is a project or a plugin, and the key of the originating project. Tags associated with each application are stored in a JSON array format, allowing for easy categorization and filtering. The 'instanceCount' column indicates the number of instances, which is zero for all entries in this dataset. This dataset can be used to audit applications, identify those that are not currently in use, and make decisions about resource allocation or application lifecycle management.
shortDesc: Dataset of applications with no instances, detailing visibility and metadata.

columns.name: onlyLimitedVisibility
columns.comment: Indicates if app has limited visibility, boolean value.

columns.name: appId
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each application, text format.

columns.name: appVersion
columns.comment: Version information of the application, text format.

columns.name: label
columns.comment: Descriptive label for the application, free text.

columns.name: shortDesc
columns.comment: Short description of the application, free text.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the application, JSON array format.

columns.name: isAppImg

columns.name: origin
columns.comment: Source of the application, either project or plugin.

columns.name: originProjectKey

columns.name: instanceCount
columns.comment: Number of instances of the application, integer value.

columns.name: useAsRecipe

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL for accessing the application, string format.
